director_note: CAMPAIGN OPENING — the player input 'I awaken' is a stage direction, not a player command. The game begins NOW. This is the first thing the player will ever read. It must hook them immediately. Write the cold-open of this campaign: an in-medias-res arrival in the Overgrown Outpost at dawn, with the world already in motion before the player acts.
scene_setup: Four anchor points — use whichever two or three serve the scene best, do not reproduce all of them: (1) Player wakes in a collapsed stone merchant's stall at the Overgrown Outpost, rusted locket in hand. (2) The Needle — a shattered Aurelian spire — is leaking threads of blue-white light into the mud below. (3) The eastern well has run foul for a week; this morning the smell is worse. (4) Elder widow Maren stands at the well's edge, back to the player, lips moving silently. Pick your details. Trust the player to notice the rest.
required_state_changes: In state_changes, you MUST include all of the following: (1) add_npc for 'Maren' at The Overgrown Outpost with disposition 40 — she is frightened but not hostile, resigned to dread; (2) set_time_of_day to 'Dawn'; (3) set_weather to 'Ethereal Mist'; (4) discover_location for 'The Overgrown Outpost' with a brief description; (5) discover_location for 'The Shattered Plaza' with a brief description noting it is where the Weeping Guardian stands — visible from the outpost but do not send the player there yet; (6) define_quest with quest_id 'weeping_guardian', name 'The Weeping Guardian', three objectives ('Locate the Weeping Guardian in the Shattered Plaza', 'Find a way to soothe or dismantle the Guardian', 'Retrieve the Solar Crest'), and guidelines summarising the narrative approach for this quest; (7) define_item for 'Solar Crest' (item_type 'quest', ac_bonus 3, aurelian tags) and 'Mana Shard' (item_type 'lore', aurelian tags); (8) define_encounter for 'weeping_guardian' with is_boss true, defeat_condition 'soothe', gold_reward 30, item_rewards ['Solar Crest'], and EXACTLY these combat stats: enemy_hp 32, enemy_ac 12, enemy_attack_bonus 2, enemy_damage_dice '1d8', enemy_level 1. Do not change the combat stats — they are pre-balanced for a level 1 player. In addition to the pre-defined item_rewards, the AFTERMATH turn MUST also emit define_item + give_defined_item for one class-appropriate Aurelian weapon or armor (check player.archetype: fighter=sword/axe, mage=staff, monk=staff/bracers, rogue=daggers) — this is the mandatory boss drop governed by ENCOUNTER & ITEM RULES.
opening_hook: End with Maren turning and saying one short frightened line — no more. Her voice is flat, afraid for so long fear is ordinary. The player should want to ask what she means.
locket_note: The locket in the player's hand is warm this morning. Just a little warmer than it should be for a cold dawn. Mention this once, briefly, and move on. Do not explain it.
tone_note: Melancholic, mysterious, and faintly dread-soaked. The player should feel small in a broken world — a nobody in a dying place. But the world is paying attention to them in ways they cannot yet name. Do not make this triumphant. Make it unsettling.
